defsZh:
vi. 期滿, 呼氣, 斷氣
vt. 撥出

examples.zh: 你的駕駛執照已經過期了。

defsEn: lose validity

defsZh:
n. 資料夾, 摺紙機, 摺疊式書本, 卷宗
[計] 資料夾

examples.en: I've lost one of my folders.
examples.zh: 我丟了我的一個資料夾。

defsEn: a small book usually having a paper cover

defsZh:
n. 影印, 影印件
v. 影印
defsEn: a photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work

defsZh: vt. 更新, 革新, 重新整理, 修復, 使恢復活力

examples.en: Our venue wasn't renovated too long ago.
examples.zh: 我們的場地不久前翻新了。

examples.en: My neighbor renovated her house completely.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居把她的屋子翻新了一遍。

defsEn: restore to a previous or better condition

defsZh: a. 陽光充足的, 樂觀的, 快樂的, 像太陽的

examples.en: I wonder if it will be sunny outside.
examples.zh: 我想知道天會不會變晴。

examples.en: The first time feels like a sunny day.
examples.zh: 這是初次的感覺，好像天空般晴朗。

examples.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
examples.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

defsEn: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

defsZh:
n. 日曆, 日程表
vt. 列入表中
[計] 日曆

examples.en: I hang the calendar on the wall.
I hung the calendar on the wall.
She hung the calendar on the wall.

defsEn: a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year

defsZh:
n. 捐贈物, 捐款, 捐贈
[經] 贈品, 捐款, 捐贈

examples.en: Would the girls please bring the donation boxes up to the stage?
examples.zh: 我們請女孩帶著募捐箱來到舞臺。

defsEn: a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause

defsZh:
n. 反饋, 反應
[計] 反饋

examples.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
examples.zh: 公司歡迎消費者對他們產品的反饋

defsEn: the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output

defsZh: adv. 不久, 簡短, 唐突地

examples.zh: 湯姆很快就會加入我們。

examples.en: My grandfather died shortly after my birth.
examples.zh: 我出生不久之後我的爺爺就去世了。

examples.en: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
examples.zh: 事故發生後不久，警察來了。

defsEn: for a short time

defsZh:
n. 小吃, 點心, 快餐
vi. 吃零食, 吃快餐

defsZh:
n. 倉庫, 貨棧, 大商店
vt. 儲入倉庫

examples.en: Hide it inside the warehouse for now.
Tom waited for Mary in front of the warehouse.
Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?
examples.zh: 是誰忘了把倉庫的門鎖上？

defsEn: a storehouse for goods and merchandise

defsZh:
n. 謄寫者, 模仿者, 抄寫員
[計] 複製機

examples.en: Are you here to fix the copier?
Do you know what's wrong with the copier?
I'm off to the library to use the copier.

defsEn: apparatus that makes copies of typed, written or drawn material

defsZh:
n. 供應者, 供養人, 伙食承辦人
[計] 提供器

examples.en: God is the best of providers.
Sami is the sole provider for the family.

defsEn: someone whose business is to supply a particular service or commodity

defsZh:
n. 飲料
[化] 飲料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)

examples.zh: 你最喜歡的飲料是什麼？

examples.en: What beverages do you like to drink?
I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

defsEn: any liquid suitable for drinking

defsZh:
a. 飢餓的, 荒年的, 渴望的, 不毛的
[化] 欠鞣皮
defsEn: feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food

defsZh:
n. 檢驗, 檢查, 視察
[醫] 檢查, 視察, 監督, 望診

examples.en: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.
examples.zh: 韓國允許了國際原子能總署的視察。

defsEn: a formal or official examination

defsZh:
a. 領受的, 容易接受的, 感受性強的
n. 領受者, 容納者, 容器

examples.en: Don't flip-flop the addresses of the sender and recipient!
examples.zh: 不要把寄件人、收件人地址的姓名填反了！

defsEn: a person who receives something

defsZh:
n. 走廊, 側廊, 過道
[機] 走道

examples.en: I'd like an aisle seat, please.
Would you like a window or aisle seat?

defsEn: a long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods)

defsZh:
vt. 檢查, 檢閱, 檢驗
vi. 檢查

examples.zh: 幹部們視察了我們的學校。

examples.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
examples.zh: “我必須檢查下傷口，”醫生說道。

examples.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
examples.zh: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？

defsEn: look over carefully

defsZh:
n. 機械工, 技工
a. 手工的

examples.zh: 這名技師組裝了這臺引擎。

examples.en: Sami has just been to the mechanic.

defsEn: a craftsman skilled in operating machine tools

defsZh:
n. 合併, 歸併
[經] 購併

examples.en: The news of the merger of the two companies broke yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天突然傳出了兩間公司合併的訊息。

examples.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
examples.zh: 自從公司合併了以後，一切都變得十分混亂。

defsEn: the combination of two or more commercial companies

defsZh: n. 英式足球
defsEn: a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal

defsZh:
n. 毛衣, 毛線衫, 運動衫, 出汗者
[化] 發汗器
defsEn: a crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body

defsZh:
n. 成分, 因素
[化] 配合劑; 拼料; 成分; 組分

examples.en: He added another ingredient to the pot.
examples.zh: 他又往鍋裡加了一種食材。

examples.en: Peas and carrots are common ingredients in soups.
examples.zh: 豌豆和胡蘿蔔是做湯的常見配料。

defsEn: a component of a mixture or compound

defsZh:
vt. 重寫, 改寫, 改寫新聞, 書面答覆
vi. 修改舊作
n. 改寫的作品
[計] 重寫
defsEn: something that has been written again

defsZh:
n. 旅程, 旅行指南, 遊記
a. 巡迴的, 旅程的

examples.en: Everyone agrees to stay here for the night and make long-term itinerary decisions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 大家同意先在這裡住一晚，行程的事情明天再從長計議。

defsEn: an established line of travel or access

defsZh: n. 工作場所, 工廠, 車間

examples.en: Wienczysława is the most beautiful brunette in the workplace.
examples.zh: Wienczysława是這個工作場所裡最美麗的黑髮女人。

examples.en: It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
examples.zh: 在職場中對某人產生好感是很正常的，但記得要保持專業形象。

defsEn: a place where work is done

defsZh: n. 建築師, 設計者, 締造者

examples.en: A famous architect built this house.
examples.zh: 一個有名的建築師造了這個房子。

defsEn: someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)

defsZh: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的時候

examples.en: The house has all the conveniences.
examples.zh: 這套房子設施便利齊全。

examples.en: The convenience store ran out of business.
Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
examples.zh: 你有空的時候來喝杯茶吧。

defsEn: the state of being suitable or opportune

defsZh:
a. 有資格當選的, 合格的
n. 有資格者, 合格者, 適任者

examples.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
examples.zh: 如果他年輕一點，他將很適合這個職位。

defsEn: qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen

defsZh: a. 戶內的, 室內的

examples.en: In severe weather, it's best to stay indoors.
examples.zh: 天氣惡劣的時候盡量不要外出。

defsEn: located, suited for, or taking place within a building

defsZh:
n. 行李
[經] 行李
defsEn: cases used to carry belongings when traveling

defsZh:
n. 刻度盤, 鐘面, 轉盤
v. 撥

examples.en: In the case of fire, dial 119.

defsEn: the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours

defsZh:
n. 容器, 集裝箱
[化] 集裝箱; 貯存箱; 容器(任何一種)
defsEn: any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)

defsZh:
n. 抽屜, 開票人
[計] 抽屜

examples.en: I put it in the drawer.

defsEn: a boxlike container in a piece of furniture; made so as to slide in and out

defsZh:
n. 實驗室, 研究室
[醫] 凝乳酶

examples.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

defsEn: a workplace for the conduct of scientific research

defsZh:
n. 屈服, 服從, 謙恭, 呈遞, 提交, 意見
[經] 提交, 提出, 提交公斷

examples.en: We have the alternative of death and submission.
examples.zh: 我們要選擇是死亡還是臣服。

examples.en: Islam is submission to one god.

defsEn: something (manuscripts or architectural plans and models or estimates or works of art of all genres etc.) submitted for the judgment of others (as in a competition)

defsZh:
n. 公告, 佈告, 公報
[電] 電子佈告欄

examples.en: Tom put the list on the bulletin board.
We can get a weather bulletin every day.
Was there a need to air that news bulletin?

defsEn: a brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)

defsZh:
n. 證書, 證明書
vt. 發給證明書, 用證書批准, 用證書證明

examples.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.

defsEn: a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

defsZh: n. +體育館, 體育訓練, 體育課, 體操

examples.en: Are you going to the gym today?
I'm going to register at a gym.
We played basketball in the gym.

defsEn: athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
